title: MCT6 is an intestinal Lac-Phe exporter required for metformin-associated weight loss
title_zh: MCT6是肠道Lac-Phe分泌器，必需用于二甲双胍相关减重
abstract: Metabolites are increasingly recognized as circulating molecules that regulate physiology, yet the mechanisms that couple local intracellular production to organism-wide action remain poorly defined. Using the anorexigenic metabolite N-lactoyl-phenylalanine (Lac-Phe) as a model system, we identify the orphan transporter MCT6/SLC16A5 as a physiologic intestinal Lac-Phe exporter. This mechanism controls the extent to which intracellularly synthesized Lac-Phe acquires systemic activity. MCT6 transports Lac-Phe in vitro, mediates Lac-Phe efflux in cells, and is required for maintaining normal circulating Lac-Phe levels in vivo, particularly following metformin treatment or high-intensity exercise. High-fat-diet-fed mice with global or intestinal epithelial-specific deletion of MCT6 exhibit resistance to metformin-associated weight loss. Bypassing the transport defect with exogenous Lac-Phe normalizes the body weight phenotype of MCT6-knockout (KO) mice. These data connect MCT6 to Lac-Phe and gut glycolytic flux and underscore the importance of transporter-mediated release in the conversion of an intracellular metabolic state into a circulating metabolite effector.
abstract_zh: 代谢物越来越被认为是调节生理的循环分子，但将局部细胞内产生与全身作用相连的机制尚不清楚。以食欲抑制代谢物N-乳酰基苯丙氨酸（Lac-Phe）为模型系统，我们发现孤儿转运蛋白MCT6/SLC16A5是肠道内的Lac-Phe分泌器。该机制控制细胞内合成的Lac-Phe获得系统活性的程度。MCT6在体外转运Lac-Phe，在细胞中介导Lac-Phe的外排，并且在体内维持正常循环Lac-Phe水平，尤其在二甲双胍处理或高强度运动后。高脂饮食喂养的全局或肠道上皮特异性缺失MCT6的小鼠表现出对二甲双胍相关减重的抵抗。通过外源性Lac-Phe绕过转运缺陷，可恢复MCT6敲除（KO）小鼠的体重表型。这些数据将MCT6与Lac-Phe及肠道糖酵解通量联系起来，并强调转运蛋白介导的释放在将细胞内代谢状态转化为循环代谢效应物中的重要性。
